description: This file is a PHP script generating an HTML page for configuring remote management settings on a network device, including remote access protocols, ports, IP address ranges, and IPv6 addresses. It includes embedded JavaScript for UI interactions and validation.

methods.name: remote_access_allowe
methods.description: Enables remote access options in the UI based on current switch states.

methods.name: remote_access_block
methods.description: Disables remote access options in the UI.

methods.name: IsBlank
methods.description: Checks if input fields with a given prefix are all blank.

methods.name: GetAddress
methods.description: Concatenates values of input fields with a given prefix into an address string separated by a specified separator.
